responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s main diagnostic infrastructure. It separates fatal internal errors from normal token-associated errors and warnings, exports printf-style immediate reporting helpers, constructors for buffered error chains, token-positioned string emission routines, and flush/abort operations, making it the primary interface for syntax and semantic diagnostics throughout the parser passes and support modules.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the mcError pair: it only declares the diagnostic types and reporting procedures that other modules import, whereas mcError.mod contains the concrete buffered error-record implementation, formatting logic, include-stack reporting, and abort behavior.
